- **Accounting**
  - **Introduction**
    - [Accounting Introduction](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounting-introduction.md): Understand ERPNext Accounting features, ledgers, invoices, payments, taxes, banking, inventory accounting, controls, closing, and financial reports.
    - [How Transactions Affect the Ledger](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/how-transactions-affect-the-ledger.md): Learn how ERPNext invoices, payments, stock transactions, assets, returns, and adjustments create General Ledger, Payment Ledger, and Stock Ledger entries.
    - [Understanding Debit and Credit](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/understand-debit-and-credit.md): Learn how debit and credit work in ERPNext with balanced examples for sales, purchases, payments, stock, expenses, and depreciation.
    - [Accounting Workflows by Business Type](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounting-workflows-by-business-type.md): Choose an ERPNext accounting workflow for goods, retail, services, subscriptions, drop shipping, manufacturing, purchasing, or intercompany operations.
  - **Accounting Setup**
    - [Accounts Settings](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounts-settings.md): Configure invoicing, payments, credit limits, assets, closing, reports, and other accounting behavior in ERPNext Accounts Settings.
    - [Company accounting defaults](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/company-accounting-defaults.md): Configure receivable, payable, cash, bank, income, expense, Cost Center, rounding, and exchange accounts for an ERPNext company.
    - [Fiscal Year](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/fiscal-year.md): Create, assign, and manage fiscal years in ERPNext and understand how they differ from accounting periods and year-end closing.
    - [Chart Of Accounts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/chart-of-accounts.md): Structure, create, maintain, and verify ledger and group accounts in the ERPNext Chart of Accounts.
    - [Cost Center](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/cost-center.md): Create a Cost Center hierarchy in ERPNext and use it to analyze income, expense, budgets, and profitability.
    - [Bank Accounts and Modes of Payment](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/bank-accounts-and-modes-of-payment.md): Configure banks, company bank accounts, ledger accounts, and Modes of Payment in ERPNext for accurate payment processing and reconciliation.
    - [Payment Terms](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-terms.md): Create ERPNext Payment Terms and templates for due dates, deposits, instalments, milestones, and early-payment discounts.
    - [Setting Up Taxes](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/setting-up-taxes.md): Configure tax accounts, sales and purchase tax templates, Tax Categories, Tax Rules, and item-specific rates in ERPNext.
    - [Default Receivable / Payable Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/default-receivable-payable-account.md)
    - [Accounting Setup Checklist](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounting-setup-checklist.md): Use this ERPNext accounting setup checklist to verify company, accounts, banking, taxes, opening balances, controls, and go-live testing.
  - **Migration and Opening Balances**
    - [Accounting Migration Overview](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounting-migration-overview.md): Plan and complete an ERPNext accounting migration using a clear cutover scope, clean source data, the correct import tools, reconciliation, and finance approval.
    - [Prepare and Map Legacy Data](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/prepare-and-map-legacy-data.md): Clean, map, classify, and validate legacy accounting data before importing masters, invoices, balances, stock, and assets into ERPNext.
    - [Import Accounting Masters](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/import-accounting-masters.md): Import ERPNext accounting masters in dependency order using Data Import, test representative records, correct failures, and validate links and defaults.
    - [Import Chart of Accounts](<https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/chart-of-accounts-importer>)
    - [Opening Balance in Accounts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/opening-balance.md): Enter ERPNext opening accounting balances without double counting invoices, payments, stock, or assets, then reconcile the opening Trial Balance.
    - [Import Outstanding Invoices with the Opening Invoice Creation Tool](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/opening-invoice-creation-tool.md): Import outstanding Sales and Purchase Invoices into ERPNext with correct parties, dates, currencies, ageing, and reconciliation controls.
    - [Opening and Closing During Migration](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/opening-and-closing.md): Close the legacy accounting period, load ERPNext opening data in sequence, reconcile it, freeze the accepted period, and control later corrections.
    - [Import Advances, Unallocated Payments, Bank, Stock and Asset Balances](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/import-advances-unallocated-payments-bank-stock-and-asset-balances.md): Import ERPNext opening advances, unallocated payments, bank and cash, stock, fixed assets, deferred amounts, and foreign-currency balances safely.
    - [Validate and Correct the Migration](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/validate-the-migration.md): Reconcile ERPNext migration masters, invoices, payments, bank, stock, assets, Trial Balance, and financial statements, then correct errors safely.
    - [Balance in Temporary Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/balance-in-temporary-account.md)
    - [ERPNext QuickBooks Migrator](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/quickbooks-migrator.md): The built-in ERPNext QuickBooks Migrator has been removed. Review the legacy instructions and use supported ERPNext import tools for current migrations.
  - **Sales and Receivables**
    - [Selling Cycle Ledger Impact](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/selling-cycle-ledger-impact.md)
    - [Sales Invoice](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/sales-invoice.md): Learn how to create, submit, and collect payment for a Sales Invoice in ERPNext, including taxes, stock updates, ledger impact, and common fixes.
    - [Credit Note](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/credit-note.md): Create full or partial credit notes in ERPNext, return stock, reverse receivables, and allocate or refund customer credit.
    - [Accounts Receivables](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounts-receivables.md): Review customer outstanding balances, ageing, payments, and credits with the Accounts Receivable report in ERPNext.
    - [Process Statement Of Accounts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/process-statement-of-accounts.md): Generate, download, and email customer account statements and ageing summaries in bulk with ERPNext.
    - [Sales Interest / Dunning](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/dunning.md): Set up formal overdue-payment reminders with interest, fees, letter text, and payment processing in ERPNext.
    - **Subscription**
      - [Subscription](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/subscription.md): Configure recurring customer or supplier billing with plans, invoice timing, taxes, discounts, and billing history in ERPNext.
      - [Subscription Plan](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/subscription-plan.md): Create an ERPNext Subscription Plan to define the item, price, billing interval, payment gateway, and accounting dimensions used for recurring invoices.
      - [Subscription Settings](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/subscription-settings.md): Configure grace periods and automatic cancellation for unpaid recurring invoices generated by ERPNext subscriptions.
    - [Why Use a Common Receivable Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/common-receivable-account.md): Use a shared receivable control account while retaining customer and invoice-level balances in ERPNext.
    - [Allocating Credit Note and Payment](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/allocating-credit-note-and-payment.md): Allocate customer payments and credit notes against outstanding sales invoices with ERPNext Payment Reconciliation.
    - [Accounting for Bad Debts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounting-for-bad-debts.md): Write off a customer bad debt in ERPNext with a Journal Entry linked to the outstanding Sales Invoice, then verify the receivable and expense postings.
  - **Purchase and Payables**
    - [Purchase Cycle Ledger Impact](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/purchase-cycle-ledger-impact.md)

    - [Debit Note for Price Adjustment](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/debit-note-for-price-adjustment.md): Reduce a submitted ERPNext Purchase Invoice when a Supplier lowers the agreed price without returning goods.
  - **Banking and Payments**
    - **Banking**
      - [Banking](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/banking-in-erpnext.md): Set up bank accounts, import statement transactions, record payments, and reconcile bank activity in ERPNext.
      - [Bank](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/bank.md): Create an ERPNext Bank master and configure statement transaction mapping for a financial institution.
      - [Bank Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/bank-account.md): Create ERPNext Company and party Bank Accounts and connect them to the correct bank ledger.
      - [Bank Guarantee](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/bank-guarantee.md): Track guarantees received or provided, their validity, beneficiary, margin, charges, and references in ERPNext.
      - [Bank Transaction](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/bank-transaction.md): Import, review, match, reconcile, and troubleshoot bank statement transactions in ERPNext.
    - **Payments**
      - **Set up Payments**
        - [Mode of Payment](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/mode-of-payment.md): Set up cash, bank, card, and other payment methods in ERPNext.
        - [Payment Terms Template](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-terms-template.md): Create reusable installment and due-date schedules for ERPNext transactions.
      - **Receive and Make Payments**
        - [Payment Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-entry.md): Record customer receipts, supplier payments, transfers, advances, and allocations in ERPNext.
        - [Payment Request](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-request.md): Request and track online or offline customer payments from ERPNext transactions.
        - [Payment Order](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-order.md): Prepare and control bulk supplier payments in ERPNext.
        - [Receiving Bulk Payments](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/receiving-bulk-payments-in-erpnext.md): Record and allocate one customer receipt across multiple invoices in ERPNext.
        - [Advance Payment Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/advance-payment-entry.md): Record and later allocate customer or supplier advances in ERPNext.
      - **Special Payment Scenarios**
        - [Stale Cheque Accounting](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/stale-cheque-accounting.md): Reverse or replace an expired check while preserving the ERPNext audit trail.
        - [Payment Entry for Capital Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-entry-for-capital-account.md): Record owner or shareholder capital introduced into ERPNext bank or cash accounts.
        - [Book Petty Cash Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/petty-cash-entry-in-erpnext.md): Record petty cash funding and expenses with a clear ERPNext audit trail.
        - [Invoice Discount in Payment Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/managing-invoice-discount-in-the-payment-entry.md): Record a settlement discount while clearing an ERPNext invoice.
        - [Advance in Separate Party Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/advance-in-separate-party-account.md): Post and allocate advances through a separate receivable or payable account in ERPNext.
        - [Additional Charges in Payment](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/handing-deductions-in-payment-entry.md): Record bank fees, withholding, write-offs, and other payment differences in ERPNext.
        - [Post Dated Cheque Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/post-dated-cheque-entry.md): Record and clear post-dated checks without recognizing bank settlement too early in ERPNext.
      - [Payment Ledger](<https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/payment_ledger>)
      - [Managing TDS / TCS Deduction by Customer in Payment Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/booking-customer-deducted-tds-in-payment-entry-in-erpnext.md): Record customer-withheld tax and clear the related ERPNext invoice correctly.
    - **Reconcile Payments and Banks**
      - **Reconcile and Allocate Payments**
        - [Payment Reconciliation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/payment-reconciliation.md): Allocate unlinked payments and credits against ERPNext invoices.
        - [Single Payment Against Multiple Invoices](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/single-payment-multiple-invoices.md): Allocate one ERPNext payment across several customer or supplier invoices.
        - [Semi-Auto Payment Reconciliation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/semi-auto-payment-reconciliation.md): Use ERPNext suggestions to match unallocated payments and invoices efficiently.
        - [Handling Excess Customer Payments](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/handling-excess-customer-payments.md): Record overpayments and keep the excess available for future ERPNext invoices or refunds.
        - [Reconcile Advance Payment Made to the Supplier](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/reconcile-advance-payment-made-to-the-supplier.md): Allocate a supplier advance to later Purchase Invoices in ERPNext.
      - [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/bank-reconciliation.md): Match ERPNext accounting vouchers with bank statement transactions and balances.
      - [Process Payment Reconciliation Tool](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/process-payment-reconciliation-tool.md): Run queued payment reconciliations and monitor their results in ERPNext.
      - [Unreconcile Payments](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/unreconciliation.md): Remove an incorrect ERPNext payment allocation without deleting the original voucher.
    - **Other Banking Facilities**
      - [Invoice Discounting](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/invoice_discounting.md): Record invoice-backed short-term financing, disbursement, settlement, charges, and receivable accounts in ERPNext.
  - **General Ledger, Journals and Adjustments**
    - [Journal Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/journal-entry.md): Create balanced Journal Entries in ERPNext, understand account rows and references, verify General Ledger postings, and reverse an incorrect entry safely.
    - [Journal Entry Template](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/journal-entry-template.md): Learn how to create and use Journal Entry Templates in ERPNext to preload recurring accounts, dimensions, entry settings, and other accounting details.
    - [Inter Company Journal Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/inter-company-journal-entry.md): Create linked Inter Company Journal Entries in ERPNext, record both companies' debit and credit treatment, and verify each company's separate ledger posting.
    - [Repost Accounting Ledger](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/repost-accounting-ledger.md): Safely regenerate General Ledger entries with Repost Accounting Ledger in ERPNext, preview old and new postings, process vouchers, and verify reports.
    - [Accounting Entries](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/accounting-entries.md): Learn how common ERPNext transactions create balanced debit and credit entries, from owner funding and purchases to sales, expenses, payments, and closing.
    - [Immutable Ledger](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/immutable-ledger-in-erpnext.md): Understand ERPNext immutable ledger behavior, cancellation reversals, backdated stock reposting, audit trails, correction workflows, and closed-period controls.
    - [Adding reference to Journal Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/adding-reference-to-journal-entry.md): Learn how to add invoice and document references to Journal Entry rows in ERPNext, allocate receivables or payables, and verify outstanding balances safely.
    - [Finance Book](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/finance-book.md): Learn how to use Finance Books in ERPNext for alternate accounting views, company defaults, report filters, and separate fixed-asset depreciation schedules.
    - **Manage Chart of Accounts**
      - [Merging Accounts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/merging-accounts.md): Learn how to safely merge duplicate Accounts in ERPNext, verify matching properties, choose the correct target, and confirm historical ledger results.
      - [Changing Parent Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/changing-parent-account.md): Learn how to change an Account's parent in ERPNext, understand report reclassification, validate the new group, and verify the saved Chart of Accounts.
      - [Freeze an Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/freeze-account.md): Learn how to freeze an Account in ERPNext, restrict new postings, authorize exception roles, preserve ledger history, verify defaults, and unfreeze it safely.
      - [Rebuild the Chart of Accounts Tree](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/rebuild-tree.md): Learn when and how to rebuild the Chart of Accounts tree in ERPNext, repair hierarchy indexes, verify General Ledger filters, and avoid unnecessary repairs.
      - [Link Supplier and Customer with Common Party Accounting](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/common-party-accounting.md): Link a Customer and Supplier with Common Party Accounting in ERPNext, understand automatic Journal Entries, reconcile advances, and verify invoice balances.
    - **Discounts and Adjustments**
      - [Discount Accounting](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/discount_accounting.md): Configure ERPNext discount accounting to post sales discounts separately, then verify item, invoice total, and General Ledger values with a clear example.
      - [Difference Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/difference-entry-button.md): Use ERPNext Difference Entry to balance a Journal Entry, select the correct account, avoid masking errors, and verify the submitted General Ledger clearly.
      - [Book discount allowed and received separately](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/book-discount-allowed-and-received-separately.md): Book discounts allowed and received in separate ERPNext accounts using negative charge rows, then verify invoice totals, ledgers, and net payments clearly.
